title: Becky G Brings World Mental Health Day Festival to a Powerful Close in NYC & More Uplifting Moments
summary: Además, BMI impulsa a las compositoras de la música mexicana, y Lin-Manuel Miranda recibirá el Premio Corazón Latino de iHeartRadio.
body: From career milestones to new music releases to major announcements and those little important moments,  Billboard  editors highlight  uplifting moments  in Latin music. Here’s what happened in the Latin music world this week. Becky G Opens Up About Identity and Mental Health at Project Healthy Minds Event Becky G brought Project Healthy Minds’ World Mental Health Day Festival to a powerful close on Saturday (Oct. 10) in New York with an intimate conversation on identity, creativity and mental health. Moderated by NBC News correspondent Morgan Radford, the panel gave the Mexican American star space to reflect on growing up in the public eye, protecting her peace and learning to tell her story on her own terms. “The whole concept of being a role model is to model this idea of perfection, and I don’t think that is real at all,” Becky G said. “Instead of being a role model, I’ve always felt the responsibility to be a real model, which means I’m not going to have all the answers. I’m not going to get it right every single time.” She also spoke candidly about therapy, family and her healing journey, saying: “I had to become the person that I needed most, and that’s …

title: The Fitbit Edge just made Google’s wearable lineup better than you think
summary: The latest fitness tracker is only part of a bigger plan.
body: None of us had it on our bingo cards this year, but Google has surprisingly emerged as the company with the best wearable ecosystem on the market. The new Fitbit Edge not only carries forward the legacy of the Fitbit Charge from the bygone era but also gives Google a solid chance to put its best foot forward in a wearable market that has already picked sides. But beyond a lineup that addresses (nearly) every consumer need on the spectrum, Google has, more importantly, created an underlying platform that is actually shaping its fitness ecosystem for the long run.

summary: The Ministry of Health in Iraq, in collaboration with the World Health Organization (WHO), confirms that there is no suspected case of Ebola virus disease in Iraq as of 5 January 2015.

title: Cholera update in Yemen

title: Dr Halfdan T. Mahler, WHO’s third Director-General, dies at 93
summary: WHO is saddened by the death of Dr Halfdan T. Mahler on 14 December 2016. Dr Mahler served as Director-General of WHO from 1973-1988.
